items.title: Has Lam Research (LRCX) Fallen Far Enough To Look Like A Bargain?
items.summary: Lam Research has delivered a very strong share price return of about 3.9x over the past five years, yet the broader valuation checks currently lean cautious rather than clearly cheap. After a period of sharp swings in semiconductor stocks, the question for you is whether Lam Research stock still offers value or mostly reflects high expectations already. Over five years, Lam Research has returned roughly 385.7%, which sets a high bar for any further upside to be justified by future cash flows...
